intro: Milli Featherwhistle is a master gnomish mechanostrider engineer stationed at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. Following the fall of Gnomeregan, she meticulously handcrafts and maintains the clockwork mounts favored by her kin. She sells her prized mechanical creations to fellow gnomes and trusted allies of the exiled Gnomeregan survivors.

p: Operating outdoors in the biting chill of Steelgrill's Depot just east of Kharanos, Milli Featherwhistle oversees the supply of clockwork steeds for Gnomeregan's displaced populace. Unlike the biological beasts favored by dwarves and night elves, Milli builds her entire inventory herself, personally calibrating gears, pistons, and balancing gyros to ensure each mechanical bird runs at peak efficiency across the snowy crags of Dun Morogh.

Every frame and spring in Milli's workshop is rooted in blueprints originally drafted by High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque. While Milli has integrated modern performance improvements over the years—streamlining chassis weights and refining exhaust vents—she faithfully adheres to the High Tinker's foundational schematics. Her mechanical wonders prove that even in exile, gnomish technological ambition remains thoroughly unbroken.
